title: TargetObservationV2
description: kc.target_observation/2: the held cube's remaining bounded advance along the reach axis, as the proven executor computes it from a stationary pad observation. Both stamps are on the robot's monotonic clock. Everything else the relay knows about the observation is evidence it records, never on the wire.

contract.description: the version word; a v1 consumer drops a document carrying it (fail closed)

capture_ns.description: the robot's monotonic stamp read BEFORE the capture was asked for: the capture's identity and age

published_ns.description: the relay's monotonic now at THIS publication (same clock); the command must echo it as timestamp_ns and anchor its expiry to it

motion_epoch.description: the executor's count of ended motions when the capture was taken

frame.description: origin = the held cube's anchor in PAD_FRAME from the latest stationary pad observation; x = the unit reach/advance axis in PAD_FRAME; y = the left normal; metres

x_m.description: the remaining bounded advance along x for the anchor to reach the placement admission: base_advance_needed_mm / 1000, the executor's own quantity

y_m.description: the target lies on the axis by construction; lateral deviation is measured and bounded by the executor's pulse gates, never steered

max_age_ns.description: THIS observation's freshness bound, derived by the source: the perception deadline plus the relay's bounded waits; scene invariance is carried by motion_epoch and stationary, not by this bound

stationary.description: the base read at rest at the capture: no wheel above one velocity count (autonomy/manipulation/base_rest.py; the stored record's base_velocity)

observation_id.description: the stored capture this observation came from
